newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Inkombank has 596.3 bln rbl 9-mth net.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Inkombank has 596.3 bln rbl 9-mth net.

text.p: Russian commercial bank Inkombank had net profit of 596.3 billion roubles in the first nine months of the year, compared with 438.39 billion in the first half, ths bank's press service said.
The results were prepared to international acounting standards, but comparative figures for the first half of 1995 were not available.
Inkombank said its total assets were 19.23 trillion roubles on October 1, compared with 19.85 trillion three months earlier.
Shareholders' funds were 1.88 trillion on October 1 after 1.80 trillion on July 1.
